meta.name: minimal-run-and-audit
meta.description: Rigor Run skill for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use when the task is specifically to capture or normalize evidence from the selected smoke test or documented inference or evaluation command and write standardized `repro_outputs/` files, including patch notes when repository files changed. Do not use for training execution, initial repo intake, generic environment setup, paper lookup, target selection, hidden scientific-meaning changes, or end-to-end orchestration by itself.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑通论文仓库的推理或评估命令,归档成可复核的复现结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有需要复现的深度学习论文仓库,想留下可核查的运行证据
copy.tagline_en: Run a paper repo's documented commands and archive checkable reproduction evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must reproduce a deep-learning paper repo and keep verifiable run evidence

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会执行你选定的冒烟测试、推理或评估命令，把结果整理成标准化的 repro_outputs/ 文件，并区分已验证、部分完成和受阻三种状态。仓库文件有改动时另附补丁说明。
howto.when: 在已确定复现目标和环境方案之后，需要短时非训练类验证命令的执行证据时接管；仓库初期扫描、环境未定时不适用。

say.text: 跑一下这个冒烟测试，结果写进 repro_outputs/
say.note: 会执行命令并产出标准化输出文件。

say.text: 这次推理运行的对比情况整理成 COMPARABILITY_REPORT.md
say.note: 生成 README、论文与基线的可比性报告。

say.text: 我改过仓库文件，把补丁记到 PATCHES.md 里
say.note: 记录改动，不隐瞒科学含义变化。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs your chosen smoke test, inference, or evaluation command and writes the results into standardized repro_outputs/ files, marking each as verified, partial, or blocked.
howto.when_en: Triggers after a reproduction target and setup plan exist, when a short non-training command needs execution evidence and reporting. Not during initial repo scanning.

say_en.text: Run this smoke test and write the results into repro_outputs/.
say_en.note: Executes the command and writes standardized output files.

say_en.text: Organize this inference run's comparison into COMPARABILITY_REPORT.md.
I changed repo files — record the patches in PATCHES.md.
say_en.note: Logs the edits without hiding scientific meaning.
